To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a goal programming model can be used to determine the prices of services in a library, where the prices are determined so as to maximize the total revenue from the library, subject to a number of constraints.

1) the direct and variable costs of library operations should be recovered through unit charges on direct services provided, 2) the joint fixed costs of library operations are a function of the characteristics and functions of institutions using the library, 3) these joint fixed costs can be allocated to the various institutions through the solution of a goal programming model, and 4) this approach provides a basis for a more rational assessment policy for a medical library.

the constrained goal programming approach provides an effective means of setting service prices that are equitable and fair and which recover the costs of the direct and variable costs of library operation.
